title: AION 2 Gladiator: Starter Build and Tanking
description: Build a Gladiator around useful passives, MP recovery, and defensive timing for solo play or party tanking.
summary: Start with sustainable melee damage, select your unlocked skill options, and equip protection when your party asks you to tank.
quickAnswer: Gladiator is a heavy melee fighter with damage, self-recovery, and defensive tools. Build a sustainable attack loop, then equip protection when your party needs you to tank.
